convert_featurized_vector_to_scene: convert a numpy array of featurized objects into a PHYRE scene representation
convert_featurized_vector_to_raster: convert a numpy array of featurized objects into a height by width raster of color codes
parse_object_features_to_values: parse a single object feature vector into a dictionary of x, y, angle, diameter, color, and shape properties
build_scene_from_featurized_objects: build a PHYRE scene with bodies and user input balls from a featurized objects numpy array
visualize_featurized_representation: visualize the featurized representation of PHYRE scenes by converting objects to raster images
